facts.text: Hastings College uses a block schedule where students take two 4-credit courses per block.

sources.title: Hastings College Block Schedule
sources.quote: Two Classes at a Time. You take just two 4-credit courses per block. Focus, finish them and move seamlessly on to the next two.
